messages:
deploy-bot: initiating rollout release/2026.04.02 -> prod. feature flag `response_cache_v2` -> canary, pinned binary=v2.0.0. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. cc @nina @omar for ramp plan.

nina: ack. ramp proposal: 1% -> 6% -> 25% -> 100%. soak durations 10m/15m/20m. health gates: 5xx < 0.35%, p95 delta < +85ms, synth-quality < 1.5%. manual hold at each step.

omar: added release notes with exact revert commands and pin: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-04-02-cachev2. rollback snippet: `deploy-bot revert-flag response_cache_v2 && deploy-bot pin-service v1.9.7`.

kai: add auto-safety: if p95_delta > +120ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.7% for 3m then auto-mute and notify #incidents. ops set alerts for OOM and router retries. Also request a quick prefetch run to warm cache keys before each bump.

deploy-bot: dry-run OK. reserving 8 canary hosts and toggling to 1% now. logs: `[2026-04-02T02:03:10Z] flag set to 1% (cohort=canary)`

nina: canary live. starting 10m soak. monitors: @ops-oncall @kai.

[6m later]
ops-oncall: brief p95 blip +70ms on host-02 for ~90s, no 5xx. executed cache-prefetch and cleared stale entries on host-02.

omar: holding promotion until soak completes. if blip persists we'll pin back host and re-evaluate.

[after soak]
nina: metrics steady. promoting to 6%.

deploy-bot: flag set to 6%. quality-sampler started (n=100 every 5m).

kai: at 6% we see increased router retries from one edge cluster due to a short TTL mismatch. bumping TTL to reduce retry storms; monitoring.

ops-oncall: TTL adjustment applied, retries dropping. holding 15m soak as planned.

[soak complete]
nina: metrics stable, synth failures 0.9%. proceeding to 25% after minor notes in relnotes about prefetch step and TTL tweak.

omar: documented exact pin-back, added snippet to run `deploy-bot pin-service v1.9.7` if roll back needed.

[final note]
ops-oncall: final checks: alerts and rollback commands confirmed in runbook. post-roll follow-up assigned to @nina (update relnotes) and @kai (monitor for 2h). deploy-bot: proceed with planned ramp when ready.

end thread.
